verdict.rationale: Bitwarden's own docs say users can save passkeys in the vault and autofill them on websites and apps through the browser extension, mobile apps and desktop apps. This goes beyond the TOTP-only authenticator features documented elsewhere. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of passkey sign-in, and deeper first-party detail on the passkey sign-in flow and platform limits beyond a one-line summary.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app stores passkeys and signs me into websites and apps with them, not just TOTP codes

citations.quote: Save passkeys in your Bitwarden vault and use the browser extension, mobile apps, or desktop apps to autofill them across the apps and websites you use every day.
